label: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY
not_a_claim: CONFIRMED_LOCAL is a descriptive local effect on a frozen corpus with a SYNTHETIC-vintage close (S34); it is uncharged and not walk-forward, so it is not a scored claim.

corpus.description: data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet x close_join, 16322 states 2019-08-02..2026-05-24, outcome = over 2.5 goals

rows.reason: the ingredient is a live (team, time-bucket, score-bucket) cell from the StatsBomb event cache; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet has no score_state or time_bucket column -- its eleven feature columns are pregame shot/SOT as-of aggregates. The section's own ledger status is a REPLICATED NULL; it parses as wired here only because the status string contains 'REPLICATED'

the trigger is the in-match first-goal event and the outcome is the match result; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet carries no first_goal column, holds no in-match states, and its scored label is the over-2.5-total-goals indicator, not a result label

the trigger is a live leading-versus-tied score state at StatsBomb event grain and the outcome is shots per minute; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet has no score-state column and no shot-rate outcome, only pregame as-of shot/SOT differentials

the ingredient is shot-grain shot.type.name (Corner / Free Kick versus Open Play); no set-piece share column exists in data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet -- diff_shots_for_asof and diff_sot_for_asof pool every shot type and cannot be split by origin

the PPDA proxy (opponent passes divided by own Pressure+Duel+Interception count) is an event-grain quantity recomputed in memory by validate_pressing_defense.py; no ppda column is persisted in data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet and the outcome is an opponent turnover rate, not the corpus over-2.5 label

the trigger is goal-kick pass height at StatsBomb event grain and the outcome is possession retention on that pass; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet carries no goal_kick or distribution column and scores a pregame match-total label
the trigger is an in-match Tactical Shift event with pre/post shot-rate windows; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet carries no tactical_shift column and holds no in-match states

the trigger is a neutral_venue flag measured on data/domains/soccer_intl/results.parquet (49,425 played matches, 1872-2026); data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet is six domestic league corpus_units with no neutral column, and none of those international matches is a corpus row

the same neutral_venue ingredient as the row above, split by era on the soccer_intl corpus; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet carries no neutral column and does not contain those matches, so neither the trigger nor the era split can be built at corpus grain

the trigger is a competitive-versus-friendly competition label on data/domains/soccer_intl/results.parquet; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet holds only the six domestic league corpus_units (E0, E1, D1, F1, I1, SP1) and carries no competition-type column, so the friendly arm of the contrast does not exist in it at all

the ingredient is diff_xg_supremacy_asof from the data/domains/soccer as-of xG family; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet carries no xG column at all -- its as-of family is shots and shots-on-target (diff_shots_for_asof, diff_sot_for_asof), a different quantity, and the claim is a split-half persistence property of the trait rather than a per-match trigger

the trigger is the in-match minute of a team's first substitution and the outcome is a shots-per-minute shift around it; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet carries no substitution column and holds no in-match windows
the trigger is a live trailing-versus-tied score state, the same absence as the leading/tied row; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet has no score-state column and no shots-per-minute outcome

the unit is a within-match possession id carrying per-shot statsbomb_xg; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet is match-grain with neither a possession nor an xG column, and the claim is a calibration property of summed shot xG rather than a pregame trigger on the match label

the predictor is an event-grain compactness proxy (own defensive-action mean x minus own shot mean x) and the outcome is the play_pattern=='From Counter' share of a team's own shots; neither exists as a column in data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_soccer.parquet
